description: Defines the Payload interface for representing the payload of an adaptable entity in the Eclipse Ditto protocol, including methods for constructing and retrieving payload properties such as path, value, metadata, etc.

classes.name: Payload.JsonFields
classes.description: Contains definitions for the JSON fields used in serializing and deserializing Payload objects.

methods.name: Payload.newBuilder(final JsonPointer path)
methods.description: Creates a new PayloadBuilder initialized with the given path.

methods.name: Payload.newBuilder()
methods.description: Creates a new PayloadBuilder without a pre-defined path.

methods.name: Payload.newBuilder(final Payload payload)
methods.description: Creates a new PayloadBuilder initialized with properties copied from an existing payload.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Retrieves the path associated with the payload.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the optional value contained in the payload.

methods.name: getExtra
methods.description: Retrieves optional extra JSON enrichment attached to the payload.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the optional HTTP status code associated with the payload.

methods.name: getRevision
methods.description: Retrieves the optional revision number of the payload.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Retrieves the optional timestamp of the payload.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves the optional metadata associated with the payload.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Retrieves the optional field selectors for the payload.
